Thank you to the amazing Senoia community for showing up, celebrating, and making this weekend so special! A huge thank you to the City of Senoia and the Downtown Development Authority for their dedication in making this celebration possible.

From our moving flag ceremony honoring our new Veterans Memorial, to the Freedom Run 5K, an unforgettable performance by David Lee Murphy, Six Piece Suits, and spectacular fireworks lighting up the sky both nights, every moment reflected what makes Senoia such a special place.

Thank you to everyone who volunteered, participated, sponsored, attended, and celebrated with us.

Photos by Emmanuel Brooks

fieldData.post-body:
We would like to congratulate the Downtown Senoia Business of the Month, Maguire's Irish Pub.

‍

Maguires Family and Friends restaurant and Irish Pub opened its doors on St. Patrick’s Day 2008.

Owned by Frank and Wendy Maguire, working along side their three children, they are now in their second generation of this true family business. It is their mission to honor their heritage by always providing the great food, great fun, and great service upon which their Grandmother and Grandfather prided themselves.

Maguires has a menu that can make anyone happy, from Fish and Chips, to Cottage Pie, and have you had the Reuben Spring Rolls? ( My personal favorite).  Their drink menu also has something for everyone, with a nice variety of beer and wine, and their handrafted cocktails such as the Irish Old Fashioned.

Happy Hour is daily from 2-6pm, where you can choose from discounted appetizers, and $4 house wines and cocktails, and select draft beer specials.

All of Senoia looks forward to the St. Patrick’s Day Shenanigans, and Maguires does not disappoint! This year the fun begins on Saturday, with Kegs and Eggs at 8am, and finishing the day with a performance by the Kelly Porter Irish Dancers at 6pm. The fun continues into Sunday, and then Monday is the big day, beginning at 8am, with events all day!

Downtown Senoia is fortunate to have such a great establishment that truly cares about its customers and their experience.

‍
fieldData.post-summary: Downtown Senoia's Business of the Month, Maguire's Irish Pub.
fieldData.name: Senoia's Business of the Month

fieldData.post-body:
Hi, everyone. Steve Maloy here. Thank you for your interest in the 2024 Senoia Car Show. I'm going to give you a quick overview of your advance ticket options, including both reserved and non-reserved parking. Reserved options include Main Street, of course. To get started, scroll down the page until you see the Advanced Show Car Registrations button.

Click on this button, and you'll see a map of Main Street showing all the reserved parking spots available on Main Street. You can scroll up and down the map and see all the parking spaces on Upper Main Street and down to the stage on Lower Main Street. You'll be able to scroll the map, hover over any available parking spaces, and reserve up to two spots.

Each time you hover over a spot and select it, you'll be asked to confirm your selection. 


For general non-reserved parking, simply choose the number of spaces you want in that drop-down box.

Once you have confirmed your selections, scroll to the bottom of the map and click on the green next key. 

Fill out all the information required, including your contact information and information about each vehicle you have reserved. Please make sure you acknowledge that you have read and accepted the terms and conditions before you move on to the next screen and enter your credit or debit card and billing information.

If you need help, please call this Welcome Center at (770) 727-9173.

‍

You can view the short video below for an overview.

‍

fieldData.post-body:
Thank you all for volunteering to make Light Up Senoia a great event! I sincerely appreciate your Christmas Spirit. We are several weeks away from the big day, but we need a few more volunteers. Many of you volunteer for several of our events during the year and I applaud your willingness to serve. Because our events are getting bigger and more numerous, we need to expand our volunteer core. You as a civic minded person are our best voice for this effort. Please consider asking a friend or a neighbor to join you. It’s fun and we need you. If you have any questions you can call me at anytime. If you need to switch things around so your friend or neighbor can work with you we can do that, just send me a note or call.

Thank you again for your dedication. See you there!

Here’s the volunteer link: https://volunteersignup.org/PMWA4

‍Sincerely,
Jack Martin
Event Coordinator
404-925-2404
jackmartin76@gmail.com

The Senoia Downtown Development Authority is proud to announce the availability of special commemorative banners to honor and recognize the valiant service of Veterans in the United States Armed Services.

Each custom-made banner will feature the Veteran's name, photograph, and branch of service, creating a powerful visual testament to their service. The banners will be displayed proudly, and prominently along Main Street. This initiative is designed to bring our community together in paying respect to the men and women who are serving and have served our nation with honor.

Each banner is $150
‍

Deadline: April 1st, 2026

‍
Please send a photo of your Veteran to chairman@enjoysenoia.com to be used on their banner. Preferably from Coweta County.

‍

Photos below are from previous years. In honor of Veterans Day in November, we host a brief ceremony to present these banners to each Veteran and/or their families.

fieldData.post-body:
The Senoia Downtown Development Authority (DDA) is proud to announce the availability of its new Enjoy Senoia website. This new site, found at both enjoysenoia.net and enjoysenoia.com, will be the place to keep up with DDA and community events in downtown Senoia.

Residents, visitors, and downtown merchants can get the specifics on upcoming and past events, view DDA meeting agenda and minutes, see the latest Instagram posts from EnjoySenoia, and a downtown business directory complete with maps, business hours, contact information, and much more.

The new site will be growing and evolving as we gather feedback from site visitors and downtown businesses. Please send us your feedback, comments, and suggestions to webmaster@enjoysenoia.com.

‍

‍
